input.quote: 12.1.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated in accordance herewith, shall continue in force and effect until (a) the date of expiration of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or (b) the expiration of the License Option Period and the failure of AbbVie to exercise the License Option (such period, the "Term").
input.rationale: There is no auto-renewal mechanic in this agreement, so the RENEWAL rule's risk (an evergreen term with a long non-renewal notice window and uncapped price uplift) does not arise. Section 12.1.1 sets a single self-limiting Term running from the Effective Date until expiry of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or until the License Option Period lapses unexercised; searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "extend the Term", "successive" and multi-year renewal patterns produced no operative renewal or notice-window language, and no renewal price-increase provision exists. The structure is favourable to us as customer: no notice is required to avoid an unwanted extension, and on expiry under clause (a) our Section 5.1.3 grants convert to a non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable licence (Section 12.1.2), so expiry improves rather than degrades our position. Any extension would require mutual written amendment, which matches the preferred position (renewal only by mutual written agreement). No redline proposed.
